description: Over the MMP Memo pairs (equal up to position p, different at p), which row pairs (a.id < b.id) does Memo equality match when written as an INNER JOIN ON, as a comma join WHERE, which pairs does Memo < order, and which rows does a Memo IN-subquery and a Memo = scalar-subquery against row 1 select?
